memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Then the tent of meeting and the camp of the Levites will set out in the middle of the camps. They will set out in the same order as they encamp, each in their own place under their standard. - Num 2:17 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
When Israel travelled, the tent of meeting moved in the very middle of the camp, carried by the Levites, surrounded on all sides by the tribes. God did not lead from a distance behind them, nor from far ahead out of sight — He journeyed right in their midst.

This is a wonderful picture of how God is with His people. He is not a far-off God who watches from the clouds. He placed His presence right in the centre of the camp, moving as they moved, resting as they rested. Wherever they went, He went with them.

Life is a journey, and the road is not always smooth. There are wilderness stretches, unexpected turns, and long stages of waiting. But the same truth holds for us: God is not distant. He is in the midst of His people.

This finds its fullest meaning in Jesus, whose name Immanuel means "God with us" (Matt 1:23). In Him, God came to dwell among us. And by His Spirit, He now lives within every believer (1 Cor 3:16).

So whatever journey you are on today, remember — God is not watching from far away. He is right in the middle of it with you, moving as you move, present at every step.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you live as though God is with you or far away?
- How does it change your day to know God journeys with you?
- Where do you most need to sense His presence right now?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that You dwell among Your people and within me. Help me to walk through today aware that You are right here with me. Amen.
